question: Count the number of counties that experienced an increase in unemployment from 2015 to 2018, using 5-year ACS data, and a decrease in dual-eligible enrollee counts between December 1, 2015, and December 1, 2018.
sql:
WITH unemployment AS (
  SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(a.unemployed_pop, a.civilian_labor_force) as unemp_rate_2015,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(b.unemployed_pop, b.civilian_labor_force) as unemp_rate_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` b ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
),
dual_eligible AS (
  SELECT 
    FIPS,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Date = '2015-12-01' THEN Public_Total END) as de_2015,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Date = '2018-12-01' THEN Public_Total END) as de_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cms_dual_eligible_enrollment.dual_eligible_enrollment_by_county_and_program`
  WHERE Date IN ('2015-12-01', '2018-12-01')
  GROUP BY FIPS
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as county_count
FROM unemployment u
JOIN dual_eligible d ON u.geo_id = d.FIPS
WHERE u.unemp_rate_2018 > u.unemp_rate_2015
  AND d.de_2018 < d.de_2015
